subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my earlier email about acquiring paid subscribers who stay billed. Here is the fresh angle: premium SVOD held weighted-average monthly churn at 4.6 percent across 2025 (Antenna 2026), and 26 percent of subscribers cancel right after finishing the title they came for (Churnkey 2026). Against a consumer subscription acquisition band of 80 to 250 dollars (magiclogix 2026), trials that never bill quietly inflate your real cost per paying subscriber. Optimizing to the cleared first payment is what closes that gap. Worth comparing against your current mix?
angle: fresh angle: SVOD churn/retention economics (sourced) + consumer subscription CAC band
register_notes: Stage 2 EN subscription_media (US SVOD): acknowledges 2nd follow-up + references prior email; fresh angle = retention/churn economics (premium SVOD monthly churn 4.6 percent, Antenna; 26 percent cancel-after-content, Churnkey) tied to the real consumer subscription CAC band 80-250 dollars (magiclogix); no MobUpps figure this stage; 1 question mark; no sign-off; no X-not-Y; all market context REAL and web-verified with URLs from the parent's verified set; native English.
